annotations.title: Dior Collaborates with Artist Mickalene Thomas
Monumental animal art infuses Chanel's gleaming couture show
Guggenheim Museum and Converse Form Global
Art and pop culture collide as global powerhouse KAWS makes Canadian museum debut at the AGO | Art Gallery of Ontario
Fashion Collaborations | Dior x Duncan Grant x Charleston - DACS

content.text:
Here are **notable art-related collaborations from 2023**, especially where contemporary art crossed into fashion, design, museums, and public art:

| Collaboration | Type | Why it mattered |
|---|---|---|
| **Louis Vuitton x Yayoi Kusama** | Fashion / luxury / fine art | One of the biggest art-fashion collaborations of 2023, with Kusama’s signature polka dots, pumpkins, and infinity motifs appearing across Louis Vuitton products and global store installations. |
| **Dior x Mickalene Thomas** | Haute couture / contemporary art | Dior worked with artist **Mickalene Thomas** for its Spring 2023 couture setting and imagery, connecting Thomas’s visual language with Black female icons and art-historical references. ([harpersbazaar.com](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/fashion/fashion-week/a42634749/mickalene-thomas-dior-couture-spring-2023/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Chanel x Xavier Veilhan** | Couture runway / installation art | Chanel collaborated with contemporary artist **Xavier Veilhan** on monumental animal sculptures and a theatrical couture show environment for Spring 2023. ([apnews.com](https://apnews.com/article/9f40ea41aebcf16e2d3b0282681458c6?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Guggenheim Museum x Converse** | Museum / youth culture / design | The Guggenheim and Converse announced a global partnership in 2023 focused on supporting younger creatives and connecting modern and contemporary art with youth culture. ([guggenheim.org](https://www.guggenheim.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/press-release-converse-guggenheim-global-partnership-announcement-20231109.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **KAWS x Acute Art / Art Gallery of Ontario** | Museum / augmented reality | The AGO’s 2023 exhibition **KAWS: FAMILY** included augmented-reality works produced with **Acute Art**, extending KAWS’s practice into digital and interactive formats. ([ago.ca](https://ago.ca/press-release/art-and-pop-culture-collide-global-powerhouse-kaws-makes-canadian-museum-debut-ago?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Dior x Duncan Grant / Charleston** | Fashion / historic art licensing | Dior incorporated work by British artist **Duncan Grant** through a collaboration involving Charleston and DACS, showing how historic artworks can be translated into contemporary fashion products. ([dacs.org.uk](https://www.dacs.org.uk/news-events/fashion-collaborations-dior-x-duncan-grant-x-charleston?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Fendi x BLESS** | Design / fashion / installation | At Design Miami 2023, Fendi collaborated with the transdisciplinary studio **BLESS** on an immersive design project blending fashion, function, and art-world presentation. ([crash.fr](https://www.crash.fr/bless-and-fendi-collaboration-at-design-miami-2023/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Louvre x Uniqlo** | Museum / mass fashion | The Louvre continued its collaboration with Uniqlo in 2023, bringing museum imagery and art-historical references into accessible apparel. ([presse.louvre.fr](https://presse.louvre.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/7916221136605bd76cefa2809573a0bd.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Perrier-Jouët x Fernando Laposse** | Design / art / luxury | Champagne house Perrier-Jouët collaborated with Mexican artist-designer **Fernando Laposse** on **Seeds of Life**, presented during DESIGNART Tokyo 2023. ([designart.jp](https://www.designart.jp/designarttokyo2023/assets/pdf/designart_tokyo2023_press_release_no4_en.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Beyond Granite: Pulling Together** | Public art / civic collaboration | A major 2023 public-art initiative on the National Mall in Washington, D.C., bringing multiple contemporary artists into dialogue with monuments, history, and public space. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beyond_Granite%3A_Pulling_Together?utm_source=openai)) |

If you mean **“art collaborations” specifically as in artist-to-artist collaborations**, rather than **art x fashion/brand/museum collaborations**, the list would be different.
